data.body:
Re-censused the literal `ticket-quality` / `ticket_quality` surface on main at 3b80ff04452 (slices 1-6 merged, slice 7 in flight). Use `git grep -cF -e 'ticket-quality' -e 'ticket_quality'` — a regex like `ticket.quality` matches the unrelated phrase "per-ticket quality-gate" and inflates the count.

Slice 7 (in flight) clears tests/unit/test_prompt_variants.py (16) and tests/unit/test_execution_mode.py (15).

Remaining after slice 7, grouped into the next three slices:

S8 — test repoint, 27 hits across 9 files: test_prompt_library_writes.py 8, test_prompt_index.py 7, test_prompts_git_canonical.py 4, interfaces/store/test_llm_framework.py 3, test_prompt_front_matter.py 1, test_prompt_cache_split.py 1, test_generated_surface_markers.py 1, interfaces/store/test_agent_op_safeguard.py 1, external/test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py 1.

S9 — examples, docs and id-normalization illustrations, 7 hits across 6 files: llm/workflow/examples/review_skeleton.yaml 1, tests/unit/workflow/test_review_skeleton.py 2, docs/workflow-engine.md 1, docs/llm-framework.md 1, docs/reuse-surface.md 1, llm/prompting/prompts.py 1. The last two are only illustrations of id normalization (`ticket_quality.md` -> `ticket-quality`); swap them to `code_quality.md` -> `code-quality`. S9 also carries the 4 deferred slice-6 doc advisories (see 1461-32c3-eb41-48cc), which touch these same two doc files.

S10 — retire the prompt: delete src/rebar/llm/reviewers/ticket_quality.md (4) and regenerate src/rebar/llm/reviewers/index.json (4).

Three file classes are OUT of scope for every absence-AC, because each is a frozen or derived artifact rather than a live reference. Scope absence-ACs to `src docs tests` and exclude docs/release-notes.md.

1. docs/release-notes.md (10) — historical narrative recording the removals; it must keep naming what was removed.
2. evals/plan-review-gate/runs/*.jsonl (5 across 4 files) — frozen eval input corpora and run records. They quote ticket descriptions as they stood when the run executed.
3. .test_durations (8) — a tracked pytest-split timing cache. Two of its entries are already stale (tests/unit/test_eval_solver.py::test_ticket_quality_case_runs_and_scores and ::test_ticket_quality_good_case_no_fire no longer exist, removed by the EVAL slice). pytest-split ignores unknown node IDs, so stale entries are harmless and the file regenerates. S10 will strand the remaining parametrized IDs the same way. No slice should hand-edit it.
